concept.title: Turning Lane Keeping Assist ON and OFF

conbody.p: To turn Lane Keeping Assist ON or OFF, press and hold the Lane Driving Assist () button on the steering wheel while the vehicle is ON.
The gray or green indicator () appears on the instrument cluster if you turn ON Lane Keeping Assist.

li.p: If Lane Keeping Assist is not met, the gray indicator () appears on the instrument cluster.
If Lane Keeping Assist is met, the green indicator () appears on the instrument cluster.

section.title: Automatic Activation
section.p: Lane Keeping Assist automatically turns on in the following situations:

li.p: When both Lane Following Assist (LFA) and Smart Cruise Control (SCC) are activated.
When Highway Driving Assist (HDA) turns on. (if equipped)

section.p: If Lane Keeping Assist is automatically turned on under these conditions, attempting to turn off Lane Keeping Assist will display a warning, and Lane Keeping Assist will not turn off.
To turn off Lane Keeping Assist, temporarily deactivate Smart Cruise Control or turn off the driving assistance functions by pressing the Lane Keeping Assist or Driving Assist button, then try again.

li.p: Lane Keeping Assist will remain on even if you turn off the driving convenience functions.
When the vehicle is restarted, the Lane safety will maintain the last setting.
To turn off Lane Keeping Assist, temporarily deactivate Smart Cruise Control or turn off the driving assistance functions by pressing the Lane Keeping Assist or Driving Assist button, then try again.

When connecting a trailer or carrier, set the trailer or carrier menu (if equipped). If the driver manually sets the menu or the trailer or carrier connection is automatically recognized through genuine parts, the functions of the driver assistance system may be limited. Please refer to and always drive with caution.
